title: Acquire a first resolvent derivative action from three values
statement: For supplied y,v,w and0<b<=1, an explicit3-value Gaussian/chord estimator is conditionally unbiased for DK_b(y)[v]w,L2 norm<=2(1-sqrt(1-b^2))L||v||||w||,and Lp norm<=C sqrt(p)(1-sqrt(1-b^2))L||v||||w||,p>=2. It includes b=1 for the raw conservative C1,1 class without higher derivatives.

requires: Original whole-vector g values; Gaussian seeds and exact-real arithmetic
Raw conservative globally Lipschitz C1,1 source; no convexity, derivative or mean oracle
Fresh seeds conditional on acquired y,v,w; null events assigned fixed values
provides: Three finite endpoint/interior values, no limiting derivative oracle
Standalone affine-annihilating antithetic variant costs8 values,or4 in dimension1
assumptions: Dimension-free moments are not a pathwise sample bound
An action is not a common tensor or free raw Dh
costs: Paired diagnostic executes3+8=11 calls,not both estimates for8
Coupled products, random-chain tails and nonlinear law remain separate
contract.units: Original values and Gaussian Lp action moments
contract.obstruction: No acquired reusable quadratic compiler, every-execution polylog query theorem, universal bit bound, priority or practical advantage.

evidence.range_scope: Three-value derivative action, eight-value standalone antithetic or four in dimension1.

body: Chord integration, chi3 mixture and exact S=sqrt(1-rho^2) substitution prove the action. Its Gaussian tails matter to later caps.

review.scope: Actual completed audit is a separate version-bound overlay.
